title: OpenCaseLaw: A Verifiable Multilingual Citation Graph for Swiss Jurisprudence (paper companion, 2026-05-21 snapshot)
description: Companion deposit for the OpenCaseLaw paper-1 (Resource) release. Contains the compiled paper PDF, the frozen 2026-05-21 corpus/graph statistics, the citation-precision proxy run aligned with the released E_link denominator, and the RFC-6962 integrity root with its OpenTimestamps Bitcoin anchor. OpenCaseLaw is an open, verifiable Swiss legal graph that joins 972,882 court decisions across 109 courts in 28 jurisdictional layers (DE/FR/IT, 1875-2026), 8,047,620 resolved case citations (8,102,236 link-edge rows, 92.9% coverage), 11.28M decision-to-statute edges over 283,330 provisions, 8,124 article-level Materialien (Federal Council Botschaft) anchors, 362 CC-BY/CC-BY-SA scholarly commentaries, a Swiss-native cli:ch identifier with ECLI projection, and per-decision Merkle inclusion-proof verification against the Bitcoin-anchored root. Snapshot: 2026-05-21. Corpus is released separately under CC0 on Hugging Face; code is MIT on GitHub.
notes: Snapshot 2026-05-21. RFC-6962 root over 972,882 decisions: 1b597b9279334d2d2c91d03d200d3964a9825d7b6c1e200a4781b32fee81f599. OpenTimestamps Bitcoin anchor: see integrity_root_2026-05-21.bin.ots. Per-decision inclusion proofs available via https://mcp.opencaselaw.ch/api/integrity/<decision_id>. Companion evaluation paper (audit-rail diagnostics, cross-lingual retrieval, multi-annotator IAA) in preparation.
